title: Apparent molar heat capacities of aqueous NaCl solutions from 0.05 to 3.0 mol kg-1, 350 to 600 K, and 2 to 18 MPa
authors: Jeffrey A. Gates, David M. Tillett, Dorothy E. White, Robert H. Wood
experimental_method: Differential flow heat-capacity calorimeter: electric power for equal temperature rise with solution and with water flowing; cp/cp* from eq (1) with heat-loss factor f from the White and Wood calibration (3 mol/kg NaCl at 17.7 MPa); NaCl(aq) 0.05 to 5 mol/kg, 349 to 598 K, 1.87 to 17.90 MPa.
uncertainties_stated: Per-point accuracy delta printed (from +/-0.00015 in Ps/Pw and 1 per cent in DeltaP/P); f may be in error by 1 per cent (systematic, not included); T accurate to 0.1 K at 300 K and 0.3 K at 600 K; p +/-0.25 MPa; fit standard error 8.00 J/(K mol) over 447 points.
quality_remarks: Rows at m 3.97 to 4.99 mol/kg (footnote d) and 2 rows with large residuals (footnote e) were excluded from the authors' fit; all are kept. Large replicate scatter at m = 0.05 and 0.08 mol/kg (e.g. 451.99 K/5.05 MPa: -155.46 and -269.29 J/(K mol) for 0.0503). One molality printed 0.4868 in a 0.4968 series (451.99 K, 1.87 MPa), consistent with its Cp,phi; kept. Molality 1.9990 at 451.99 K/17.40 MPa versus 1.9880 elsewhere, printed so. Temperature scale not stated. The table also includes measurements outside the title range (to 4.99 mol/kg).
